questions.question:
Oysters are generally either dark or light in colour. Dark oysters excel in 
dark environments, while light oysters thrive in bright environments. 
Intermediate-coloured oysters are disadvantaged, lacking effective 
camouflage in either setting. 
Which type of natural selection does this phenomenon exemplify? 
 
(a) directional 
(b) stabilising 
(c) disruptive 
(d) (The phenomenon described does not exemplify natural selection.) 
1

hunting. 
 
Which stage of human evolution is this creature NOT from? 
 
(a) Homo erectus

Benign tumors- remain confined to their original location and do 
not spread to other parts of the body and cause little damage. 
Malignant tumor cells grow very rapidly, invading and damaging 
the surrounding normal tissues of other organs.  
Malignant tumors are lethal as cancer cells move from the tumor 
to new sites through the blood to form secondary tumors. 
This invasion of cancer cells from one part to other parts by the 
body fluids is called metastasis.                                                 (3)
